title: Head data extracted from a verifier state
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let a verifier state consist of the encoded fields specified for that machine. Its associated head data is the head data stored in the state when present, and otherwise is the default pair consisting of no machine state and position $0$.
